templateVersion.description: SPEC-09 RE.8: new exports never emit v1, so this is always 2.

tenantId.description: Required for tenant/agent login; omitted for platform login.

affectedCells.description: Rate cells PostgreSQL changed, summed over the contract versions in the batch.

updates.description: FR-059 range-based rate edits: date ranges x rate plans x day-of-week masks. Each is applied through the same rate-grid dry-run and confirm direct authoring uses (SPEC-09 RE.4).

contractsCreated.description: Contracts the confirm actually created from the staged rows.

affectedCells.description: Rate cells written from the DailyRates sheet, through the rate grid's own confirm.

rows.description: A v1 workbook: SPEC-09 RE.8's own v1, whose sell_from/sell_to are booking dates, or the flat sheet this product shipped, whose effectiveFrom/effectiveTo are travel dates. Absent masks backfill to 127 and absent versions to 1 before anything is validated or hashed.

sheets.description: A v2 workbook. SPEC-09 RE.8's three sheets; send this or rows, never both.

detectedTemplate.description: Which shape arrived, so a caller still on v1 knows it is on borrowed time.

canonicalHash.description: SPEC-09 RE.8: a v1 and a v2 representation of the same data produce the same digest. Returned so that can be proved rather than trusted.

base_amount.description: Non-negative NUMERIC(14,4) as a decimal string. contracting.daily_rates checks base_amount >= 0 and stores four decimal places, so a signed or longer-scaled value describes a row the catalog refuses.

names.th: กรุงเทพมหานคร

canonical.summary: Supplier has not confirmed the room

canonical.subject: Your booking
canonical.messageBody: The hotel has confirmed your room.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: SPEC-09 RE.7: the draft etag the caller last read. When supplied it is enforced, so a patch is never validated against a grid the caller has not seen.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: SPEC-09 RE.7: a replay of this key with the same payload returns the original outcome; the same key with a different payload is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
